questions.body: Which SQL clause is used to filter rows BEFORE they are grouped?
questions.explanation: WHERE filters individual rows before GROUP BY runs. HAVING filters groups after aggregation, which is the most common confusion.

questions.body: Which of the following statements about a PRIMARY KEY are true? Select all that apply.

options.body: It uniquely identifies each row in the table
A table can have at most one primary key
It must be a single column

questions.explanation: A primary key is unique and non-null, and a table has only one (it may span several columns, so a composite key is allowed).

questions.body: Explain the difference between passing an argument by value and by reference, and describe one situation where the difference changes a program's output.
questions.modelAnswer: By value copies the argument so changes inside the function do not affect the caller's variable; by reference passes access to the original so changes are visible to the caller. Example: a function that increments its parameter leaves the caller's number unchanged when passed by value but updates it when passed by reference.

rubric.criterion: Correctly describes pass by value (copy semantics)
Correctly describes pass by reference (shared original)
Gives a valid example where output differs

questions.explanation: Tests understanding of parameter passing beyond definitions: strong answers connect the semantics to an observable effect.
